page.overview:
What is Kopi Kopi no Mi?

The Kopi Kopi no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to copy other people's appearances and abilities. It was eaten by Chameleone.

"Kopi" is the Japanese way to pronounce the word "copy".

The main power of this fruit is to copy other people's abilities. It seems that the user needs to see the person once in order to copy their power, making it a dangerous gamble to engage or even be near the user. However, the user needs a great concentration in using this ability as seen when Chameleone stops using his powers whenever he sneezes. Otherwise, the user is affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Chameleone uses his power to steal others powers for his own sake. Some of the Devil Fruit users he has copied are Luffy, Smoker, Ace and Kizaru.
